ops.title: e2e: wedged verifier lane exits the host nonzero
ops.description: Integration gap flagged by the daemonkit pool-wedge refuter review (2026-07-24): TestRuntimeTerminatesWhenWorkerClaimTerminalizes proves daemonkit's Wait returns the terminal error, but capt-hookd's consumer wiring (hostRuntime.run errors.Join at internal/hookd/server.go:106 -> serveCommand exit 1 at internal/hookd/command.go:79-87) is verified only by reading. Add an e2e that forces a settlement failure (fail-remove store seam, per daemonkit worker/pool_test.go overrun tests) and asserts the serve process exits nonzero so launchd restarts it.

ops.text: an e2e test drives a settlement failure through the real serve command and asserts exit code 1
test red if watchWorkerTerminal wiring is reverted
